propositions: merge.ours.driver is set per-clone in init.py but never committed, so reconcile-bridge.yml on the runner has an undefined merge driver and silently falls back to 3-way text merge of large JSON instead of local-wins
reconcile-bridge.yml must set merge.ours.driver=true for the tickets worktree before any merge step, whereas reconcile-bridge-canary.yml already obtains it via rebar init and does not need changes
blob:none filtering with an undefined merge driver causes the reconverge path to lazily fault large blobs mid-merge, making this a prerequisite blocker for the clone filter feature

integration tests must verify diverged-remote reconverge resolves .bridge_state/* with local-wins semantics and produces no conflict markers when the driver is set, and reproduce text-merge behaviour when it is absent
